text: Storage Write API (gRPC) offers exactly-once delivery semantics at lower pricing than the REST variant
quote: For new projects, we recommend using the Storage Write API (gRPC) instead of the Storage Write API (REST). The Storage Write API (gRPC) has lower pricing and more robust features, including exactly-once delivery semantics.

text: Storage Write API can stream records in real time or batch-commit an arbitrarily large set of records in a single atomic operation
quote: Puedes usar la API de Storage Write para transmitir registros a BigQuery en tiempo real o procesar por lotes una gran cantidad arbitraria de registros y confirmarlos en una sola operación atómica.

text: Pub/Sub BigQuery subscriptions stream high-throughput data into BigQuery in real time as it is generated
quote: Pub/Sub can handle high throughput of data loads into BigQuery. It supports real-time data streaming, loading data as it's generated.

text: Data can be replicated from databases into BigQuery in near real time
quote: This method enables replicating data from databases to BigQuery in near real time.

text: BigQuery Data Transfer Service schedules one-time or recurring batch load jobs to automate data loading pipelines
quote: you can schedule load jobs. You can schedule one-time or batch data transfers at regular intervals

text: DML statements let you insert, update, and delete data in BigQuery tables
quote: Data Manipulation Language (DML) statements enable you to update, insert, and delete data from your BigQuery tables.

text: GoogleSQL is an ANSI-compliant SQL dialect covering a broad set of statement types
quote: GoogleSQL is an ANSI-compliant Structured Query Language (SQL) that includes the following types of supported statements

text: Procedural language extensions run multiple SQL statements in one request, with variables and control flow
quote: Procedural language statements are procedural extensions to GoogleSQL that let you execute multiple SQL statements in one request. Procedural statements can use variables and control-flow statements

text: Query statements can use pipe syntax
quote: Query statements can include pipe syntax.

text: Conversational analytics lets users ask data questions in natural language, using data agents configured with metadata, glossary terms, and verified queries
quote: Conversational analytics lets you have natural language conversations with your data. You can create data agents configured with custom metadata, instructions, glossary terms, and verified queries

text: Conversational analytics supports market basket analysis questions
quote: Conversational analytics now supports questions about market basket analysis.

text: Gemini in BigQuery generates or suggests SQL and Python code and explains existing SQL queries
quote: BigQuery의 Gemini를 사용하여 SQL 또는 Python에서 코드를 생성하거나 제안하고 기존 SQL 쿼리를 설명할 수 있습니다.

text: Data canvas uses natural language to find, join, query, and visualize table assets and supports collaboration
quote: BigQuery의 Gemini로 자연어를 사용하여 테이블 애셋을 찾고 조인하고 쿼리하고 결과를 시각화하며 전체 프로세스에서 다른 사용자와 원활하게 공동작업할 수 있습니다.

text: Data insights automatically generates queries from table metadata to uncover patterns and run statistical analysis
quote: Data insights offers an automated, intuitive way to uncover patterns and perform statistical analysis by using insightful queries that are generated from the metadata of your tables.

text: AI functions bring generative AI into workflows for text summarization, sentiment analysis, and data enrichment
quote: Use generative AI in your workflows with AI functions for text summarization, sentiment analysis, and data enrichment.

text: BigQuery ML trains, evaluates, and deploys predictive models directly in BigQuery using SQL
quote: Train, evaluate, and deploy predictive analytics models directly within BigQuery using SQL.

text: Embeddings plus vector, text, or hybrid search support semantic retrieval and RAG applications
quote: Build sophisticated context-retrieval and RAG applications with embeddings and vector, text, or hybrid search to find information based on meaning, not just keywords.

text: BigQuery Graph uncovers complex relationships and patterns in data
quote: use BigQuery Graph to uncover complex relationships and patterns in your data.

text: BigQuery notebooks combine SQL queries with Python code, rich text, and visualizations
quote: notebooks let you combine SQL queries with Python code, rich text, and visualizations to tell a comprehensive story with your data.

text: Colab Enterprise notebooks support end-to-end data science and ML workflows, including building and deploying BigQuery ML models
quote: End-to-end ML workflows: build, evaluate, and deploy a BigQuery ML model within a single notebook interface.

text: Dataform lets analysts develop, test, version-control, and schedule complex SQL transformation workflows in BigQuery
quote: Dataform is a service for data analysts to develop, test, control versions, and schedule complex workflows for data transformation in BigQuery.

text: Pipelines can be created, stored, and managed in Git folders for collaborative development
quote: You can now create, store, and manage pipelines in Git folders.

text: Shows a visualization of a workflow's dependency tree
quote: View a visualization of the dependency tree of your workflow.

text: Quality tests check data correctness on source and output tables
quote: Test data correctness with quality tests on source and output tables.

text: Continuous queries run SQL continuously to analyze incoming data in real time and write output to destinations
quote: Continuous queries let you analyze incoming data in BigQuery in real time. You can write or export the output rows produced by a continuous query to the following destinations

text: BigQuery sharing lets you securely share and access live data across organizations without replicating it
quote: BigQuery sharing (formerly Analytics Hub) is a data exchange platform that lets you securely share, discover, and access data across organizational boundaries without replicating data.

text: Users can discover curated third-party and Google datasets and combine them with internal data
quote: Puoi utilizzare BigQuery sharing per scoprire set di dati curati di terze parti e di Google e combinarli con i tuoi dati interni

text: Shared data listings can be monetized on Google Cloud Marketplace
quote: Listings let you share data without replicating data, and you can monetize listings on Google Cloud Marketplace

text: Iceberg managed tables are fully managed like standard tables but store data in customer-owned buckets
quote: Iceberg managed tables offer the same fully managed experience as standard BigQuery tables, but store data in customer-owned storage buckets.

text: Iceberg managed tables interoperate with open-source and third-party engines on a single copy of data
quote: Iceberg managed tables support the open Iceberg table format for better interoperability with open-source and third-party compute engines on a single copy of data.

text: BigQuery handles structured and unstructured data and supports Iceberg, Delta, and Hudi open table formats
quote: BigQuery provides a uniform way to work with both structured and unstructured data and supports open table formats like Apache Iceberg, Delta, and Apache Hudi.

text: bq is a Python-based CLI for creating datasets, loading data, and querying tables
quote: learn how to use bq, the Python-based command-line interface (CLI) tool for BigQuery to create a dataset, load sample data, and query tables

text: A Rust SDK for BigQuery is available in Preview
quote: The Rust SDK for BigQuery is now in Preview.

text: MCP Toolbox for Databases provides an open-source MCP server for databases
quote: MCP Toolbox for Databases is an open source MCP server for databases.

text: Simba ODBC and JDBC drivers connect applications and tools to BigQuery
quote: The Simba Open Database Connectivity (ODBC) and Java Database Connectivity (JDBC) drivers for BigQuery connect your applications to BigQuery, letting you use BigQuery features with your preferred tooling and infrastructure.

text: Query results can be retrieved directly in Apache Arrow format for faster retrieval and serialization
quote: You can now retrieve query results directly in the Apache Arrow format for faster retrieval speed and improved serialization efficiency.

text: Query jobs include diagnostic query plan and timing information, similar to EXPLAIN
quote: Embedded within query jobs, BigQuery includes diagnostic query plan and timing information. This is similar to the information provided by statements such as EXPLAIN

text: Time travel gives access to historical data
quote: Time travel for historical data access in BigQuery.

text: Schema evolution lets you add, drop, and rename columns
quote: _Schema evolution_, which lets you add, drop, and rename columns to suit your needs.

text: Serverless analytics over vast data in near real time with GoogleSQL or Python and no infrastructure to manage
quote: With BigQuery, there's no infrastructure to set up or manage, letting you focus on finding meaningful insights using GoogleSQL or Python

text: Distributed engine queries terabytes in seconds and petabytes in minutes
quote: the distributed and scalable analysis engine of BigQuery allows querying terabytes in seconds and petabytes in minutes

text: On-demand pricing charges per TiB of bytes processed, with the first 1 TiB per month free
quote: On-demand pricing (per TiB). With this pricing model, you are charged for the number of bytes processed by each query. The first 1 TiB of query data processed per month is free.

text: Capacity pricing charges for compute measured in slots (virtual CPUs) over time, with the option to reserve slots ahead
quote: you are charged for compute capacity used to run queries, measured in slots (virtual CPUs) over time

text: Custom quotas cap the data processed per day at the project or user level to control costs
quote: Creating a custom quota on processed data lets you control costs at the project level or at the user level.

text: BigQuery sandbox lets you use BigQuery without a credit card or billing account
quote: The BigQuery sandbox lets you experience BigQuery without providing a credit card or creating a billing account for your project.

text: Free tier includes 10 GiB of storage and up to 1 TiB of queries per month
quote: Store 10 GiB of data and run up to 1 TiB of queries for free per month.

text: IAM controls access to datasets, tables, views, and routines with predefined roles and granular permissions
quote: Identity and Access Management (IAM) lets you control access to BigQuery resources by using predefined roles and granular permissions.

text: Data lineage tracks where data originates, how it transforms, and where it moves across BigQuery and Vertex AI
quote: Data lineage in Knowledge Catalog (formerly Dataplex Universal Catalog) lets you track where your data originates, how it transforms, and where it moves across systems such as BigQuery and Vertex AI.

text: Migration lineage service visualizes data flow in a source database to help plan a migration to BigQuery
quote: you can use the migration lineage service to visualize the data flow and connections in your source database and help you plan a BigQuery data warehouse migration

text: BigQuery is covered by compliance attestations including ISO certifications, SOC 1/2/3, and HIPAA support
quote: Google Cloud compliance resource center lists BigQuery-covered attestations and certifications including ISO 9001:2015, ISO 22301:2019, ISO 50001:2018, SOC 1/2/3, HIPAA support, and sector/regional programs, with downloadable reports per ce
